content.title: Where to watch Michigan vs. UConn in the national championship for free tonight
content.text: Michigan Wolverines guard Elliot Cadeau (3) as Michigan faces Arizona in the Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis on Saturday, April 4 2026.MLive.comIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Michigan Wolverines will take on the UConn Huskies tonight at 8:50 p.m. ET in the 2026 national championship game. Here’s everything you need to know about tonight’s title game to make sure you don’t miss a second of the action.NCAA TOURNAMENT NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP TV INFONo. 1 Michigan vs. No. 2 UConnWhen: Monday, April 6, 2026Where: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, Ind. Time: 8:50 p.m. ETChannel: TBS/TruTVBest Streaming Option: DirecTV StreamWhat channel is the national championship on?Tonight’s national championship game will be broadcast on TBS and TruTV. How can I stream the national championship?Streaming options are available through DirecTV Stream, Sling and HBO Max. National Championship Streaming OptionsDirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Choice plan offers both TBS and TruTV among over 125 other channels. These include local channels such as ABC, NBC, Fox and CBS. New customers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off the first month of their subscription. Sling: Sling offers three monthly plans that include access to TBS. Unlike other streaming services, Sling also offers day passes, allowing customers to have access to the service without having to commit to a full month. HBO Max: Live sports are available through HBO Max’s standard plan in addition to hit TV shows and movies. This includes select games on TNT and TBS. How does Sling’s day pass work?Sling offers one-, three- and seven-day passes starting at $4.99. These are one-time activations that allow fans access to Sling’s content for a limited time.
